name: cajeerengine
product_changes: Forum Edition 0.1.0: discussions, roles, reactions, subscriptions, reports and moderation.
Forum Edition 0.1.1: transactional services, repositories, validation, audit and independent release identity.
Forum Edition 0.1.2: PostgreSQL/SQLite installer, transactional initialization, migration integrity and database regression matrix.
Forum Edition 0.1.3: email verification, password recovery, session management, confirmed TOTP and SMTP delivery.
Forum Edition 0.1.4: PHPUnit, isolated HTTP and browser regressions, PostgreSQL 17/18, security and CI evidence.
Forum Edition 0.2.1: nested boards, transactional moves, sorting, publication state and safe deletion.
Forum Edition 0.2.2: inherited node ACLs, private/hidden forums, role/user rules and access-filtered discussion queries.
Forum Edition 0.2.4: transactional discussion management, merge redirects, prefixes, tags and bulk actions.
Forum Edition 0.2.5: ACL-safe breadcrumbs, accessible tree drag-and-drop, relative transactional reorder, permission matrix and effective permission inspection.
Forum Edition 0.3.0: structure integrity gate, current-principal ACL checks, consistent moderation locks and physical upgrade/rollback structure acceptance.
Forum Edition 0.3.1: member profiles, privacy, avatar and cover images, custom fields, directory and account preferences.
Forum Edition 0.3.2: durable per-user read watermarks, unread views and ACL-safe counters, publication sequences across discussion moves.
Forum Edition 0.3.3: transactional notification outbox, ACL-filtered inbox, reply/mention/quote/reaction/moderation events, preferences and worker delivery.
Forum Edition 0.3.4: topic and board subscription modes, automatic watches, durable SMTP delivery, UTC digests, retries and signed unsubscribe.
Forum Edition 0.3.6: typed reactions, public reputation, configurable achievements, ACL-aware activity, follows and ignores.
Forum Edition 0.4.0: community upgrade/rollback acceptance, conversation rate/block enforcement, separate unread and muted counters, restored profile image validation and SMTP lease safeguards.
Forum Edition 0.4.1: safe Markdown and BBCode rendering, visual editor, preview, formatted discussions and conversations, protected quote references.
Forum Edition 0.4.2: transactional private file uploads, post and conversation attachments, ACL downloads, quotas, SHA-256 and expiry cleanup.
Forum Edition 0.4.3: sanitized raster variants, inline images and galleries, durable private S3 replicas, verified recovery and media diagnostics.
Forum Edition 0.4.4: transactional polls, privacy-controlled results, question threads, answer votes and accepted answers.
Forum Edition 0.4.5: private autosaved drafts, atomic idempotent publication, optimistic edit revisions and text restoration.
Forum Edition 0.5.0: content lifecycle hardening, idempotent draft saves, revision fences for attachment edits, safe derivative retries, and integrated upgrade/rollback acceptance.
Forum Edition 0.5.2: ACL-scoped moderation cases, evidence snapshots, versioned decisions, board-level premoderation and transactional approval with reserved attachments.
Forum Edition 0.5.3: warnings, scoped sanctions, request-time expiry, session revocation and transactional appeals.
Forum Edition 0.5.4: transactional abuse budgets, registration protection, content analysis and moderation routing.
Forum Edition 0.5.5: personal data export, profile erasure, privacy center and irreversible account closure with preserved shared content.
Forum Edition 0.5.6: live trust-based contact budgets, recipient contact policies and cross-surface personal safety.
Forum Edition 0.6.0: safety center, personal report tracking, atomic report decisions and sanctions, report-and-block, integrated safety regression.
Forum Edition 0.6.2: advanced search filters, quoted phrases and exclusions, ranking and sorting, accessible title/tag/author discovery and related discussions.
Forum Edition 0.6.3: ACL-aware server-rendered public pages, canonical metadata and JSON-LD, paginated forum sitemap and robots discovery.
Forum Edition 0.6.4: transactional Redis caching, shared rate limits, durable forum outbox wakeups and worker recovery.

notes.1.0.4: Install UX release: real web/CLI installer, SQLite quick start, install lock, first admin creation, secrets generation and dist-ready release plan.
notes.1.0.5: Server automation release: doctor/fix commands, Nginx generator, aaPanel preset, systemd templates, post-install report and backup alias.
notes.1.0.6: Release UX release: source/dist release split, checksums, GitFlic artifacts, upgrade wizard, one-command updater and backup before update.
notes.1.0.7: Admin UI hardening release: production static admin SPA, route guards, CMS CRUD workflows, protected web upgrade and release hygiene.
notes.1.1.1: Admin UI hardening release: production static admin SPA, real API CRUD screens, route guards, media upload, updates/search/import-export UI and strict admin asset verification.
notes.1.0.9: Import/export and updater hardening release: content/media import, dry-run diff, maintenance mode, rollback snapshots and post-update checks.
notes.1.1.0: Extension Runtime release: PHP providers, services, hooks/events, lifecycle install/uninstall, extension migrations and assets publishing.
